description: This file defines a Windows Forms user control 'DocumentPreview' for rendering and previewing MigraDoc documents with zoom and page navigation features, utilizing PdfSharp for rendering.

classes.name: DocumentPreview
classes.description: A Windows Forms control for previewing and navigating through MigraDoc documents, supporting zoom and page controls.

methods.name: GetNewZoomFactor
methods.description: Calculates the next zoom level based on current zoom and direction (larger or smaller).

methods.name: DdlUpdated
methods.description: Updates the document rendering when the DDL string changes.

methods.name: RenderPage
methods.description: Renders the current page of the document onto a graphics context.

methods.name: FirstPage
methods.description: Navigates to the first page of the document.
